sentences.text:
Author: R. Raghunandan Rao
Bench: R. Raghunandan Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice R. Raghunandan Rao
 Writ Petition No.2921 of 2023
Order:

The petitioner claims ownership of 5 Ankanams or 40 square yards of land in R.S.No.255-C of Muthukur Village and Mandal, SPSR Nellore District on the basis of a possessory agreement of sale dated 06.05.2011.
The petitioner also contends that she has obtained license from the Gram Panchayat to run a shop in the said land.

2. The petitioner has now approached this Court complaining of the arbitrary action of the respondent No.3 and 4, who are seeking to evict the petitioner from the said land on the ground that the said land is required for road expansion.

The learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the petitioner can only be evicted from the said land under the Land Encroachment Act or the Land Acquisition Act, after payment of compensation as the case may be.

3. Sri G. Venkat Reddy, learned Standing Counsel appearing for respondent No.3 submits that the 3rd respondent has not taken any step to evict the petitioner and there is no proposal, as of now, to evict the petitioner.
4. Recording the same, this Writ Petition is closed, leaving it open to the petitioner to approach this Court in the event of any future difficulty.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO, J 15.02.2023 MJA HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO 15.02.2023
